items.difficulty_reason: The author controls the dimension of the image of each cotangent-rank stratum by applying source generic smoothness after restricting to its image, then discards the image of the critical locus.
source_caveats: The proof invokes ordinary generic smoothness on the source as a standard prerequisite. The displayed generic-fibre identification in the book's separate §21.6.4(a) proof is left on hold as an independent proof claim. Exercise 21.6.E asks for constructibility of the determinantal rank condition.
